question: A radioactive nucleus undergoes a beta-minus ($\beta^-$) decay with a total $Q$-value of $2.0 \text{ MeV}$, leaving the daughter nucleus in an excited energy state. The maximum kinetic energy observed for the emitted beta particles is only $1.2 \text{ MeV}$. The daughter nucleus subsequently transitions to its ground state by emitting a single gamma ($\gamma$) photon. What is the wavelength of this gamma photon? ($hc = 1240 \text{ eV nm}$).
